core_memory.hypothyroidism_management: Taking levothyroxine 75 mcg daily for hypothyroidism. Must take it on an empty stomach and wait 30 minutes before eating. TSH level is stable at 2.1 mIU/L. No dosage changes needed. Use a pill organizer to avoid missing doses.
core_memory.osteoarthritis_management: Currently taking acetaminophen as needed for mild pain from osteoarthritis. For more severe pain, I take meloxicam 7.5 mg as prescribed by my doctor. I don't take it daily to avoid overusing NSAIDs. My doctor also recommended glucosamine supplements, but I'm not sure if they've made a difference.
core_memory.vitamin_d_management: Adjusted vitamin D intake to 2,000 IU daily due to low levels at 22 ng/mL. Calcium supplements are also taken since the last bone density scan showed early signs of osteopenia. Doctor recommended combining calcium with vitamin K2 for better absorption.
core_memory.cholesterol_management: Taking atorvastatin 10 mg daily to manage cholesterol. Initial LDL was 130 mg/dL, and triglycerides were 140 mg/dL. Doctor prescribed a low-dose statin to improve these numbers. Cholesterol levels have been decreasing, and no side effects have been experienced.
core_memory.general_health_supplements: Taking a daily multivitamin, omega-3 supplements, and probiotics for overall health, heart health, and digestion. Since the gallbladder was removed, I sometimes take digestive enzymes after eating heavier meals to aid in digestion of fatty foods.
core_memory.medication_interactions: I monitor potential medication interactions closely. Since I take both losartan and meloxicam, my doctor advised me to limit meloxicam use due to the risk of kidney function issues with NSAIDs. I also separate my thyroid medication from calcium and iron supplements to avoid absorption interference.
core_memory.medication_management_goals: I believe my medication routine is working well. I stay organized and focused on lifestyle changes to reduce medication reliance. My goal is to stay healthy and avoid unnecessary prescriptions by managing health naturally when possible.
